changedParagraphs.after: We record email verification, company-review decisions and evidence of Terms acceptance, representative authority and Privacy Notice presentation. When marketplace functions are enabled, we process listings, enquiries, requested quantities, replies, participants and dates, including commercial information you provide. Only after confirmation is the enquiry and necessary contact information sent to MB Gate-V's configured coordination mailbox for manual brokerage. Business data can identify people, particularly named contacts and sole traders.
